records.review_notes: The full chronology distinguishes 2021-2022 drug-program partnering from a private November 23, 2022 whole-company proposal. Sun raised its nonbinding proposal in December; a December 16 exclusivity agreement was followed by ongoing diligence and unexecuted merger drafts across January 1. Final terms and board approval came January 18, 2023; the merger agreement was executed January 19 and publicly announced before market opening that day. Private exclusivity at the cutoff was not a publicly definitive control agreement. The review is bounded to the complete disclosed chronology.
records.review_scope: Whole-company definitive public announcement, checked against the complete disclosed merger chronology. Proposed ownership is not completed ownership. Agent source review, not an independent human or exhaustive first-news audit.
